g.inkscape:label: GUIDES - hide before saving to res
g.text: Page: 213.36 x 128.5 mm (42 HP). Draw in the "Artwork" layer.
This GUIDES layer is locked; hide or delete it before saving to res/TapeJam.svg.
lit button (VCVButton) 6.1 mm (dashed ring = 1 mm clearance)
screen drawn by code: artwork under it is hidden
Faint white text = labels currently drawn by code (runtimeLabels: true).
Put your own lettering in the artwork as PATHS, then set runtimeLabels false.
Rack cannot render: <text>, embedded images, CSS <style>, filters/blur,
masks, clip paths, <use>/symbols, patterns. Check with: node tools/check_panel.mjs
Moving a control? Edit tools/layout.json and re-run tools/gen_panel.mjs.
